These timeless and sophisticated pumps from Brooks Brothers feature a soft black suede upper, a sleek pointed toe, and an elegant mid-to-high stiletto heel.
Key Details & Features
Crafted with a luxurious black suede upper, these classic heels feature a sharp pointed-toe silhouette, a low-cut curved vamp that flatters the foot, a cushioned nude leather lining, and a slender matching heel.
Style & Occasion
A quintessential wardrobe staple perfect for corporate office wear, business meetings, formal events, evening dinners, or elevating tailored trousers and classic dresses.
